description: This file provides utility functions for formatting durations, timestamps, text, costs, tokens, and percentages. It also re-exports some formatting functions imported from other modules.

methods.name: export function formatMs(ms?: number | null): string { formatMs
methods.description: Formats a millisecond value into a locale string, or returns 'n/a' if the input is null or undefined.

methods.name: export function formatList(values?: Array<string | null | undefined>): string { formatList
methods.description: Concatenates an array of strings into a comma-separated list, filtering out null, undefined, or blank strings; returns 'none' if the list is empty.

methods.name: export function clampText(value: string, max = 120): string { clampText
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: export function truncateText( truncateText
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified maximum length, returning the truncated text, a flag indicating if truncation occurred, and the total length.

methods.name: export function toNumber(value: string, fallback: number): number { toNumber
methods.description: Converts a string to a number, returning a fallback value if conversion is not finite.

methods.name: export function parseList(input: string): string[] { parseList
methods.description: Splits a string by commas or newlines into a trimmed array of non-empty strings.

methods.name: export function stripThinkingTags(value: string): string { stripThinkingTags
methods.description: Removes internal scaffolding tags from a string using imported helper.

methods.name: export function formatCost(cost: number | null | undefined, fallback = "$0.00"): string { formatCost
methods.description: Formats a number as a dollar cost string, with different decimal places depending on magnitude, or returns a fallback if null or invalid.

methods.name: export function formatTokens(tokens: number | null | undefined, fallback = "0"): string { formatTokens
methods.description: Formats a token count as a string, using 'k' or 'M' suffixes for large numbers, or returns a fallback if null or invalid.

methods.name: export function formatPercent(value: number | null | undefined, fallback = "—"): string { formatPercent
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with one decimal place, or returns a fallback if null or invalid.

calls: values.filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v && v.trim()))
